verdict.rationale: This is a locally installed Agent Skill (a SKILL.md folder plus dependency-free Python tools) that generates logo files. It has no hosted service, account, or production data, so a sandbox-vs-production testing environment is a category error for this kind of product. Its 'test sheets' (pixel, one-colour and contrast checks) are design-quality checks, not a sandbox environment, and do not make the axis applicable.
